snippet.title: Arm Around! | Latin American Games Showcase TGA 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
It's way harder than it looks. But just as weird.

Arm Around! is a delightfully unhinged physics-based game, inspired by classics like I Am Bread, QWOP, and Getting Over It, where you'll face the surreal challenge of controlling a disembodied arm using nothing but your mouse: you'll control each finger, and even extend or contract the arm, by mimicking the same movements with your own!

Crawl, jump, punch and arm around to physically interact with everything in sight as you stumble through Derechín’s wild, history-defining misadventures set throughout the 20th century.

Oh, and one more thing, we're timing you, so if you feel like proving something (to yourself or to the leaderboard), you can always revisit any chapter and try to beat the clock. Do you have what it takes to get to the top?
